recent_posts.title: How Saudi Arabia travel tech is scaling under Vision 2030
recent_posts.summary: Qais Amori, Chief Digital & Technology Officer at Almosafer, discusses how Saudi Arabia's leading travel platform leverages AI across all operations, from 15% faster development to personalized customer experiences. The company takes an Arabic-first approach rather than simple localization, with over 70% of traffic coming from mobile users. Under Vision 2030, Almosafer focuses on problem-solving teams, continuous experimentation, and building technology that serves real customer needs rather than chasing trends. The interview covers technical challenges like legacy airline systems, talent acquisition in emerging markets, and the importance of cross-functional leadership in driving digital transformation.

recent_posts.title: Software delivery in healthcare according to Numan's Jamie Webb
recent_posts.summary: Jamie Webb, CTO of Numan, shares insights on delivering software quickly in highly regulated healthcare environments. He emphasizes embedding clinical voices throughout development teams, creating tight feedback loops between engineering, product, and clinical teams, and balancing speed with safety. Key strategies include working in short iterative cycles instead of projects, making business-focused technical trade-offs, and listening to engineering teams about delivery friction. Webb highlights that successful healthcare software delivery requires cross-functional teams with shared goals and deep understanding of regulatory requirements from the start.

recent_posts.title: How the Unified Design System Saves 20% in UX effort
recent_posts.summary: Saudi Arabia's Unified Design System reduces UX design time and costs by up to 20% while improving consistency across government digital services. Ahmed Rawass, UX Director at Takamol Holding, explains how the system works alongside the Digital Experience Maturity Index (DXMI) to accelerate digital transformation under Vision 2030. Key insights include the importance of local user research, accessibility integration, and combining external expertise with local cultural understanding for effective digital service delivery.

recent_posts.title: R&D to ROI: custom OCR dilemma solved with 2-month validation
recent_posts.summary: Faced with a decision between using off-the-shelf or custom OCR solutions, a company embarked on a two-month R&D process to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of developing a tailored system. Despite efforts to create an affordable custom OCR solution, the research concluded that existing services like Azure AI Document Intelligence were more viable and cost-efficient. The exploration, although not confirming the initial hypothesis, provided valuable insights into potential future developments.

recent_posts.title: Technology and product cooperation – Julien Evano interview
recent_posts.summary: Julien Evano discusses the evolving role of CTOs, emphasizing the need for them to be active participants in shaping product roadmaps and ensuring successful collaboration across departments. He highlights strategies for merging technology and product visions, establishing cross-functional teams, and promoting a data-driven, customer-centric approach. Evano also shares insights on how CTOs can contribute to business growth without overshadowing product leaders.

recent_posts.title: AI-driven software development – interview with an expert
recent_posts.summary: Michael Anyfantakis discusses the integration of GenAI in organizations, focusing on forming AI-driven teams and minimizing compliance risks. GenAI can enhance team productivity and reduce team sizes by compressing delivery times. Vigilant AI² offers tools to ensure responsible AI usage through compliance monitoring and governance. Leaders are encouraged to explore GenAI tools to understand their potential benefits.

recent_posts.title: Saudi-European cooperation in software product development
recent_posts.summary: The collaboration between Saudi Arabian and European companies in software development can offer significant advantages. It's crucial to see cultural differences as strengths and maintain open dialogue. Choosing a European partner requires evaluating metrics such as familiarity with the Saudi market, UX expertise, and financial sustainability. Effective partnerships involve thorough preparation, detailed technical specifications, and leveraging cultural differences positively.

recent_posts.title: Bridging the gap between creativity and technology in IT
recent_posts.summary: Billy Stagg, Principal Engineer at Shell, shares insights on bridging creativity and technology in IT to enhance product development. He emphasizes the importance of combining design and engineering, nurturing versatile teams with both generalists and specialists, and prioritizing design systems. AI is presented as a tool that can streamline processes and reduce barriers in technology adoption, potentially speeding up development while fostering creativity.

recent_posts.title: Infrastructure optimization. Sogelink Nederland saves 32% monthly
recent_posts.summary: Sogelink Nederland achieves a remarkable 32% monthly cost reduction through infrastructure optimization with The Software House's strategies. Key improvements include transitioning from Filestore to Google Cloud Storage, refining GKE nodes and GPU usage, reducing log volumes, and consolidating non-production databases. Future plans involve migrating OpenSearch clusters to Google Kubernetes Engine for continued savings and performance enhancement.

recent_posts.title: Digital Strategy for Saudi Arabia
recent_posts.summary: The Software House, a Polish technology company, has over a decade of successful collaboration with Saudi businesses, offering tailored digital strategies, proactive support, and a deep local presence. Their approach emphasizes cultural alignment, adaptability to changing requirements, and a commitment to high standards. They engage in face-to-face interactions, provide strong cybersecurity measures, and align with Vision 2030 initiatives, ensuring their solutions meet local market needs and regulatory requirements.
